items.text: Cobalt moves to a new core banking system Saturday, December 12, 00:00 to Sunday, December 13, 12:00 (Central Time).
A winter storm hit Austin, where Cobalt's support center is. Some support staff cannot work this week. Wait times may be longer.
A large national bank's app and website were down for most of two days this week. Many of its customers complained on social media.
